question: Quagnoth has an ability that triggers from the graveyard when it is discarded. If Yixlid Jailer is on the battlefield, does it still trigger?

expected.shortAnswer: No: with Yixlid Jailer on the battlefield, Quagnoth's last ability won't trigger.
expected.answer: If Quagnoth is discarded normally (it moves from your hand to your graveyard), its last ability triggers from your graveyard. If Yixlid Jailer is on the battlefield, it won't trigger.
